title: Neural development
excerpt: Building directly on the 3-4 year profile of "overprovisioned substrate + high energy + tightening control," the 4-5 window keeps the energy budget elevated while decisively retooling the machinery for speed and selectivity: intracortical myelination and targe
html:
Building directly on the 3-4 year profile of "overprovisioned substrate + high energy + tightening control," the 4-5 window keeps the energy budget elevated 1 while decisively retooling the machinery for speed and selectivity: intracortical myelination and targeted pruning push the MRI-observed "thinning" 2 into a regime of more selective communication, shorter local integration windows, and lower energy per transmitted bit; association tracts such as arcuate and SLF continue their climb on key metrics 3, effectively extending the cortex’s communication radius at roughly fixed power so long-range communication (incl. top-down selection) can run at higher sampling rates; large-scale graphs continue becoming more "segregated yet integrated," with clearer default-mode <-> dorsal-attention competition and a rapidly strengthening frontoparietal control ensemble 4, 5, yielding more reliable state arbitration; spectrally, peak alpha and sensorimotor rhythms speed up 6 and the aperiodic 1/f background flattens 7, consistent with briefer synaptic time constants and tighter E/I gain; and sleep spindles and slow-oscillation coupling get more coordinated 8, improving hippocampo-cortical write-back. Overall, a similar exploratory capacity rides on faster clocks, longer-reach white-matter highways, and crisper gating, so policies stabilize sooner without sacrificing the rich hypothesis search that the preschool hyper-metabolic plateau affords.
